run_trajectory_circle: run a locobot in circle trajectory tracking mode using the ilqr base controller
run_trajectory_twocircles: run a locobot in twocircles trajectory tracking mode with close loop control
run_trajectory_custom_bot: run trajectory tracking on a custom robot name like locobot_lite with proportional controller
get_trajectory_circle: get the circle trajectory states for a robot using its odom and base config
get_trajectory_twocircles: get the twocircles trajectory states by concatenating a circle and negcircle path
